visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a brightly lit indoor basketball gymnasium with white brick walls and a blue painted stripe. A group of adults, including women with pulled-back hair and men in baseball caps, are enthusiastically high-fiving and cheering for a group of young boys. The boys are dressed in black basketball jerseys with gold numbers and the team name 'GENESIS' printed on the front. One particular boy, wearing number 4, smiles broadly while being congratulated by the crowd. (2) The camera pans to follow a man with a beard and a black cap, wearing a green hooded jacket and carrying a black backpack. He stands on the court surface, which is polished light-colored wood with various colored game lines. He appears to be talking to the young players, who stand in a semi-circle around him. Other spectators are visible in the background, seated on tiered blue benches or standing near the walls. (3) The video transitions into a series of fast-paced game highlights. The young boy wearing the number 4 jersey is seen dribbling the ball across the court, maneuvering past opposing players in red and white uniforms. He performs several successful layups and jumpshots, with the basketball clearly passing through the hoop and net. The background shows a scoreboard and a large banner that reads 'CITY OF SAN MARCOS'. The lighting remains consistent and bright throughout the gym.
